gloss: favoritism toward one's own; partiality to one's own side

definitions.gloss: favoritism toward one's own; partiality to one's own side; self-serving bias
definitions.explanation: the tendency to unfairly favor people on one's own side, such as family members, colleagues, or one's own group

examples.japanese: {身贔屓|みびいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Favoritism toward your own side is not good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{身贔屓|みびいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The referee was criticized for showing favoritism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{身贔屓|みびいき}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦やめられない→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I know praising my own child is biased, I can't help it.

notes:
Combines ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (self, one's own) and ⟦{贔屓|ひいき}→贔屓：10490_hiiki⟧ (favoritism, patronage). Where ⟦{贔屓|ひいき}→贔屓：10490_hiiki⟧ can be neutral (supporting a team) or positive (being a patron), {身贔屓|みびいき} always carries a negative connotation of unfair bias toward one's own group.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身贔屓|みびいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to show favoritism
- {身贔屓|みびいき}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: a biased judgment
- {身贔屓|みびいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to go too far with favoritism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贔屓|ひいき}→贔屓：10490_hiiki⟧: favoritism, patronage — broader term, can be neutral or positive
- えこひいき: favoritism, unfair preference — similar negative connotation, more colloquial
- ⟦{依怙贔屓|えこひいき}→依怙贔屓：20939_ekohiiki⟧: favoritism — the kanji form of えこひいき
- ⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧: prejudice, bias — a broader term for biased views
